$comment: Canonical: docs/development/smoke-test-design.md (Devnet + USDC faucet sections) and docs/technical/full-stack-devnet.md (Compose stack). This file is the single source of truth for the Base fork point that the smoke-test Geth+Lighthouse devnet boots from. The genesis ingester (see issue #255) reads `block_number` and `snapshot_uri` to populate `genesis.json::alloc` from Base state at the pinned block, restricted to `ingested_addresses`. The harness then patches USDC storage to grant `harness_usdc_holder` a clean-history USDC balance — see docs for the why (no whale impersonation). `block_number` and `snapshot_uri` MUST stay in lockstep with `testing/fixtures/fork-state/CURRENT.json` (the Anvil fork-e2e fixture) so both harnesses exercise identical on-chain state. The CI manifest validator asserts this alignment. ingested_addresses now includes the four-vault demo basket assets: Uniswap V3 pools for JUNO/ZYFAI, Uniswap V4 PoolManager (holds WOON V4 pool state), Aerodrome SlipStream pool for GIZA, and the Uniswap V3 deSPXA/USDC pool — plus corresponding token contracts. A fresh fork-state snapshot capturing this expanded ingest set is needed before the devnet image can be rebuilt; see scripts/devnet/snapshot-fork.sh. ingested_addresses also includes the Aave V3 PoolAddressesProvider (0xe20fcbdb…), AaveOracle (0x2Cc0Fc26…), and the USDC price-feed chain (PriceCapAdapter 0xf52D010c… → EACAggregatorProxy 0x1550207e… → underlying aggregator 0x0fB39aE1…): Aave V3 `Pool.withdraw` calls `ADDRESSES_PROVIDER.getPriceOracle()` during its health-factor validation, so without the provider's code in genesis the withdraw STATICCALL hits a code-less account, returns empty returndata, and reverts — which made on-chain `redeem` revert even though supply succeeded (issue #894). Supply never reads the price oracle, so deposits worked but withdrawals did not.
$comment_snapshot_sha256: HARN-5 (off-chain scan remediation, issue #1026): SHA-256 content digest of the Anvil state snapshot the genesis ingester ingests (testing/fixtures/fork-state/CURRENT.anvil-state). `pinned` authenticates `block_hash` against an archive RPC but says nothing about the snapshot BYTES; this digest closes that gap. The ingester verifies the snapshot hashes to this value before constructing genesis `alloc` and rejects a substituted/corrupted snapshot. Recompute with `sha256sum testing/fixtures/fork-state/CURRENT.anvil-state` whenever the fixture is refreshed (scripts/devnet/snapshot-fork.sh).
$comment_pinned: When `pinned` is false the manifest is structurally valid but `block_hash` has not been verified against an archive RPC. The genesis ingester refuses to build a final devnet image unless `pinned` is true. Flipping this flag to true requires (a) populating `block_hash` with the real Base block hash at `block_number` and (b) updating `snapshot_uri` to point at a snapshot artifact derived from that exact block.
